name: AISchemaGen – AI Schema Generator
author: digitalstorks

sections.description:
AISchemaGen is an AI-powered schema markup plugin for WordPress. It automatically analyzes your page content and generates valid schema markup in seconds.

Why AISchemaGen?

  • 30 seconds to generate complete schema markup instead of 10 minutes
  • AI-powered auto-detection and auto-fill
  • Universal solution for all niches, not limited to one vertical
  • Google Rich Results integration for instant validation
  • All 827+ schema types included free

Free Features

  • 30 AI Generations per Month — Let AI analyze your content and generate schema automatically
  • All 827+ Schema Types — Article, Product, Recipe, FAQ, HowTo, Event, LocalBusiness, Service, Organization, Person, Course, VideoObject, ImageObject, Breadcrumb, Review, and more
  • Visual Editor — Edit schema fields with a user-friendly visual interface
  • Code Editor — Full JSON-LD code editing for advanced users
  • Live Preview — See your schema markup rendered in real-time as you edit
  • Basic Validation — Ensure your schema is valid before publishing
  • Google Rich Results Test Integration — One-click test against Google’s validator
  • Template Library — Get started fast with pre-built schema templates
  • Export/Import — Move schemas between posts or sites
  • Single Site — Fully functional on a single WordPress installation

Premium ($29/mo) — Unlimited AI Power

  • Unlimited AI Generations — No daily limits, generate as many schemas as you need
  • All 827+ Schema.org Types — Access every type in the schema.org vocabulary
  • Powered by GPT-4o Mini — Fast, accurate AI model for schema generation
  • Bulk Operations — Generate or update schemas for 100+ posts at once
  • Schema Analytics Dashboard — Track rich result performance, impressions, clicks, and CTR
  • Advanced Templates (50+) — Industry-specific templates and a template marketplace
  • Automation Rules — Auto-generate schemas on publish, schedule updates
  • Multi-Schema per Page — Add multiple schema types to a single page
  • Integrations — Advanced WooCommerce, ACF Pro, Elementor Pro, WPML support
  • Priority Support — Email, live chat, and private Slack channel

Supported Schema Types (Free)

  • Article / BlogPosting / NewsArticle
  • Product
  • Recipe
  • Review / AggregateRating
  • FAQ
  • HowTo
  • Event
  • LocalBusiness (all subtypes)
  • Service
  • Organization
  • Person
  • Course
  • VideoObject
  • ImageObject
  • Breadcrumb

Third-Party Integrations

  • WooCommerce — Automatic Product schema
  • Yoast SEO — Compatible, no conflicts
  • Rank Math — Compatible, no conflicts
  • Elementor — Widget integration
  • Gutenberg — Native block support
  • ACF — Custom field mapping

External Services

This plugin connects to the AISchemaGen API to generate schema markup using AI.

What data is sent: Post/page title and content.
When: Only when the user clicks “Generate with AI”.
Why: To generate structured schema markup.

Service provider: AISchemaGen
Terms: https://aischemagen.com/terms
Privacy: https://aischemagen.com/privacy

This plugin may also connect to the following third-party AI providers to process generation requests:

OpenAI — Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use | Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
Anthropic — Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/terms | Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the schema-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Schema AI in the admin sidebar to configure your settings.
  4. Navigate to any post or page and use the Schema AI meta box to generate schema markup.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.7 or higher / MariaDB 10.3 or higher
sections.faq:
What is schema markup?

Schema markup (structured data) is code you add to your website that helps search engines understand your content. It can result in rich snippets in search results, such as star ratings, prices, FAQ accordions, recipe cards, and more.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. You need to create a free account at aischemagen.com and connect your API key in the plugin settings. The free account includes 30 AI generations per month at no charge.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Schema AI outputs lightweight JSON-LD in the page head. The admin interface uses React but is only loaded in the WordPress dashboard, never on the front end.

Is the generated schema valid?

Schema AI includes built-in validation that checks your markup against schema.org specifications and Google’s requirements. You can also test with Google’s Rich Results Test in one click.

Does it work with my SEO plugin?

Yes. Schema AI is fully compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and other popular SEO plugins. It will not create conflicts or duplicate schema.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

The free and premium plans support a single site.

What AI models are used?

All plans use GPT-4o Mini, OpenAI’s fast and efficient model, for high-quality schema generation.

What happens if I exceed my monthly limit?

You can still manually create and edit schemas without AI. Only AI-powered generation counts toward the monthly limit. Upgrade to Pro or Premium for more generations.
